title: Garmin Multisport Activity Failure Rate
dataSources: TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), Garmin multisport activities (`garmin:multisport`), TriDot plans (`tridot:plan`), brick workouts (`brick:workout`), and transition logs (`transition:log`).
app: TrainingPeaks structured workouts, Garmin multisport FIT exports, TriDot training plans, brick workout logs, and transition timing notes ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=garmin:multisport
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(activity_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by activity_type
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Garmin multisport activity records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each activity type.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize activity_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per activity type.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which parts of your Garmin multisport activity data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
